card.name: Preservative-free and 'without' wording in preparation text
card.fires_on: The word 'contain' after 'does not', and 'without' or 'of' in phrases about additives or other ingredients in diluted solutions or diet lists. It also fires on some digits inside years or day counts.

modes.label: Does not contain / without
modes.description: Negation or exclusion words in statements about preservatives, bacteriostatic agents or added ingredients.
modes.example: ACTEMRA solutions do not<< contain>> preservatives; therefore, unused product remaining

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a year or a short count of days, mostly in the middle of the number.
modes.example: His first two one-act plays— In the Shadow of the Glen (1<<9>>03), a comedy, and Riders
